name: Louisiana Tech University
old_description: Step into one of the fastest-growing and highest-paying fields with Louisiana Tech’s Graduate Certificate in Data Science. With a booming job market — over 650% growth since 2012 and millions of new roles projected by 2026 — data science offers unparalleled career opportunities. This certificate program equips you with practical skills to access, manage, manipulate, and transform data using the latest programming techniques and popular data visualization tools.
about:
Louisiana Tech University is a public university located in Ruston, Louisiana. Founded on July 6, 1894, as a selective-admissions comprehensive institution, it has grown into a campus centered around a pedestrian-friendly quad in a town of approximately 22,000 residents.

The university offers over 135 degree and certificate programs across undergraduate, graduate, and certificate levels. Total enrollment stands at 12,039 students with a student-faculty ratio of 21:1. The academic calendar operates on a quarter system that awards semester hours, and over 90% of students receive some form of financial assistance.

Louisiana Tech serves students pursuing fields such as engineering (biomedical, chemical, civil, computer, cyber, electrical, industrial, mechanical), business (accounting, finance, management, marketing), health sciences (nursing, medical laboratory science, health informatics), computer science, education, liberal arts, and applied sciences. The institution also engages in workforce development and research partnerships, though specific industry clients are not detailed in the source material.

The university emphasizes hands-on learning and real-world applications, particularly in engineering. It is ranked the #1 Public University in Louisiana by Niche (2026), placed in the top 7% of universities worldwide by the Center for World Universities Rankings (2024), and recognized for the #1 highest early career earnings in Louisiana. The Bulldogs compete in 16 varsity sports at the NCAA Division I level in the Sun Belt Conference.

about:
Lumen Food Labs LLC, operating under the Lumen Brands name, is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. The company was founded in 2020. Ownership structure and founder names have not been publicly disclosed.

The firm provides master distributor and compliance services for consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands seeking to enter the U.S. market. Its offerings include Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP) and Qualified Importer (QI) management, FDA-certified third-party logistics (3PL) warehousing, and acting as importer of record, customs broker, clearing house, insurer, and FDA responsible party. Lumen purchases inventory upfront at wholesale prices and provides monthly accounting, sales reporting, and forecasting from its Chicago warehouse facility.

Lumen serves foreign and domestic CPG manufacturers, particularly in the food and beverage sector, that require end-to-end regulatory compliance and distribution infrastructure. Brand partners engage the company to handle facility registration, product identification, and all shipment-level compliance obligations for goods entering the United States.

The company differentiates itself by committing to purchase products upfront with no contingency, matching brand partners' investments dollar-for-dollar, and tying its own profitability directly to the successful sale of those products. This model is designed to align incentives and reduce risk for brands expanding into the U.S. market.

old_description: LuRay Textiles, Inc. is a manufacturer of knitted fabrics. We use American made yarn in the production of our cloth. We offer a variety of fabrics from cotton and polyester to Kevlar®, Nomex® and PBI®.
about:
Founded in 1984 in North Wilkesboro, North Carolina, LuRay Textiles, Inc. operates as a manufacturer of knitted fabrics. The company has remained in the same community for decades, producing textiles from a facility on Luray Road.

The company produces a range of knitted fabrics using American-made yarn, working with fibers that include cotton, polyester, and high-performance aramids such as Kevlar®, Nomex®, and PBI®. In addition to fabric rolls, LuRay manufactures wiping cloths and rags sized for tasks ranging from automotive detailing to furniture finishing. The operation handles various fabric weights and sizes, though specific production volumes and equipment details are not publicly disclosed.

LuRay’s fabrics serve the apparel and safety-apparel sectors, providing material for protective clothing and everyday wear. Its wiping-cloth line reaches automotive aftermarket customers for cleaning and detailing, as well as woodworking and furniture shops for stain and varnish application. The company does not publish a client list, but the described end uses indicate a mix of industrial, commercial, and consumer channels.

LuRay emphasizes domestic sourcing and production, stating that its yarn is American-made and that its goods are 'MADE IN THE USA BY PROUD AMERICANS.' This commitment to U.S.-based manufacturing and material supply is presented as a core differentiator for customers seeking domestically produced textiles.

name: M-Tron Components Inc
old_description: Since 1984, M-TRON Components has maintained a commitment to excellence and has provided our customers with a secure supply chain
about:
M-Tron Components Inc. was founded in 1984 in Ronkonkoma, New York. The company operates as a veteran-owned small business and a franchised distributor of electronic components, emphasizing a secure supply chain for military and commercial customers.

The firm stocks a broad inventory of semiconductors, resistors, capacitors, interconnect devices, and computer products from authorized manufacturers. Value-added services include mil-spec packaging per MIL-STD-2073, barcoding and RFID tagging to MIL-STD-129, kitting, tape-and-reel, printed circuit board assembly, and a proprietary search-and-sell network for obsolete or allocated parts. Quality management is certified to ISO 9001:2015 and AS9120:2016, the latter addressing aerospace chain-of-custody and anti-counterfeit controls.

Primary customers are the U.S. Government, its subcontractors, and OEMs in the military and aerospace sectors. M-Tron is a certified NDAA (H.R. 1540) supplier and participates in Lockheed Martin’s Star Supplier Program. The company also serves commercial accounts requiring RoHS-compliant components and traceable documentation.

M-Tron differentiates itself through a counterfeit-free zone backed by AS9120 anti-counterfeit measures, veteran-owned status, and a commitment to turning procurement challenges into production-ready assemblies. Its franchised distributor relationships and authorized product lines ensure genuine, traceable components for high-reliability applications.

old_description: M.S. Fabrication, located in Dorchester, MA, offers custom sheet metal fabrication services. There is no project we can’t handle. Our experienced team of metalworkers can flawlessly execute even the most complex designs. We operate in a large warehouse, filled with a massive selection of state-of-the-art machines designed to handle pretty much anything.
about:
M.S. Fabrication operates from a large warehouse in Dorchester Center, Massachusetts, just south of downtown Boston. The company provides custom sheet metal fabrication services, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop runs a range of forming, cutting, and welding equipment. Forming capacity includes a 12-foot Accurpress 250-ton press brake, a 10-foot Trumpf V-130 six-axis 140-ton press brake, 60-inch pyramid rolls with a 6-inch top roll, and a Buffalo angle, flat bar, and tube rolling machine. Cutting is handled by a 10-foot Accurshear hydraulic shear rated for 3/8-inch aluminum, 1/4-inch steel, and 3/16-inch stainless; a 60-by-120-inch Omax CNC water jet capable of cutting up to 6-inch thickness; and a Euromax BX 1000 with 38-inch throat and 100-ton capacity. Welding resources comprise a Miller Dynasty 350 AC/DC TIG, a Miller Matic 250 MIG with Aim spool gun, a 20-inch throat spot welder, and a 1200W fiber laser welder. The facility works with all common steel, stainless steel, and aluminum alloys.

M.S. Fabrication serves customers requiring custom sheet metal work, but specific industry sectors or named clients are not listed in its public materials.

The company emphasizes that its experienced team can handle projects of any complexity, backed by what it describes as a massive selection of state-of-the-art machines.

name: MADE Apparel Services
old_description: Founded in 2020, MADE helps creators move sewn-product ideas toward production with clarity and confidence. Whether you’re refining a first concept, improving an existing design, or strengthening a home-studio workflow, we take a structured, transparent approach that supports consistent quality and informed decision-making.
about:
MADE Apparel Services was founded in 2020 in Renton, Washington, by Heather Zager. The firm operates as an independent product development studio.

The company provides end-to-end product development for sewn goods, including pattern making using CLO3D and Alvanon digital forms, sewn prototyping, pattern grading with industry-standard CAD tools, and tech pack creation. They also offer apparel consulting and concept development. The team consists of Zager and administrative support Nirosha Rodrigo, working with clients from initial concept through production-ready deliverables.

MADE serves startups, established brands, and corporate teams developing apparel and sewn products. Client projects span equestrian apparel (Whinny Equestrian), postpartum recovery garments (Luna Azzurra Care), sustainable womenswear (Springtime & Harvest), activewear for large-chested women (Wrax), and functional accessories (The Book Carrier Bookmark).

Zager started the business to bring structured, transparent development to creators who lack technical design resources, emphasizing that better products come from better information. The consultancy differentiates itself by using 3D simulation to evaluate fit and construction early, reducing revisions and waste before manufacturing begins.

The company develops and manufactures a range of pharmaceutical products and dietary supplements, including the antihistamine Stahist T (triprolidine) in scored tablets that allow half-tablet dosing. All products are produced to high quality standards at its Louisville facility, though specific production volumes and equipment details are not publicly disclosed.

MAGNA serves the pharmaceutical, specialty pharma, and healthcare sectors, with particular focus on wound care, ostomy, and continence markets. It holds memberships in the Wound, Ostomy, and Continence Nurses Society and the Specialty Pharma Association, reflecting its engagement with clinical professionals and specialty distributors.

old_description: MCT specializes in providing installation, parts and service for truck bodies, trailers, refuse and water equipment, roll-off and trash containers, snow removal equipment, road construction equipment and custom fabrication to outfit your purchase to your exact specifications. MCT stocks over 10,000 parts for over 200 types of equipment and trailers. We strive to provide high quality parts and service to our customers. Have a hard to find part? We've got over 40 years in the business and our parts team is well seasoned in the industry to help you identify and locate those hard to find parts.
about:
MCT Industries Inc. was founded in 1974 as a family-owned operation in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company began with trailer sales and repairs and has since expanded into a full-service provider for truck bodies, trailers, and heavy equipment.

Today MCT operates a custom fabrication facility equipped with a plasma cutter, laser cutter, 20-foot press brake, and shear. The shop installs and customizes flatbeds, service bodies, dump bodies, crane bodies, and hydraulic systems, while also performing DOT inspections and building custom trailers. A parts department stocks more than 10,000 components covering over 200 equipment and trailer types, supporting both light- and heavy-duty applications.

The customer base spans government and commercial sectors. MCT holds state and CES contracts and serves state, city, and county entities across New Mexico, as well as military and federal agencies through a dedicated government manufacturing plant that handles design through full-rate production. The waste division provides roll-off service in Albuquerque and residential collection in Santa Fe, while the commercial division supplies parts, sales, service, and rentals for trailers and heavy equipment used in construction, snow removal, and agricultural spraying.

The company emphasizes its four-decade track record and a parts team experienced in locating hard-to-find components. Its government manufacturing plant offers end-to-end production from prototype to full-rate runs, a capability the firm highlights as a key differentiator.

name: MEI Electrical Contractors & Systems Integrators
old_description: MEI Electrical Contractors & Systems Integrators is a versatile full-service electrical contracting company with a 25-year proven track record of providing premier electrical, fire alarm, and security system design, installation, maintenance, testing, inspection, repair, and monitoring for commercial, industrial, educational, governmental, health care, agricultural, and residential applications throughout Vermont and New Hampshire.
about:
MEI Electrical Contractors & Systems Integrators is headquartered in Westfield, Vermont. The business traces its roots to 1991 when it was founded as Mike’s Electric, Inc. in Jay, Vermont. A branch office opened in Williston in 2013 to serve Chittenden County and western Vermont. In 2017, then‑President Adam Fortier purchased the company and relocated it to a larger facility in Westfield.

The firm operates as a full‑service electrical contractor and systems integrator. Its scope covers electrical design, installation, maintenance, testing, inspection, repair, and monitoring, along with fire alarm and security system design, installation, and monitoring. Additional services include design/build project delivery, lighting design and energy conservation, electrical service upgrades, 24‑hour emergency response, network infrastructure, access control, video surveillance, fiber optic installation, and solar/renewable energy projects. The workforce numbers over 65, including Master and Journeymen electricians, and the company participates in the Vermont Registered Apprenticeship program to train new electrical workers.

MEI serves commercial, industrial, health care, educational, agricultural, governmental (federal, state, and local), and residential customers throughout Vermont, New Hampshire, New York, Maine, and Massachusetts. It maintains long‑standing relationships with general contractors such as DEW Construction Corp., PeakCM, Bread Loaf Corporation, ReArch Company, Wright & Morrissey, and Kingsbury Companies, and holds multi‑year state and federal contracts for electrical, fire alarm, and security work.

The company states its mission is to deliver efficient, quality work at competitive prices, completing projects on time and on budget using current technology and a highly skilled workforce. It emphasizes a family‑focused workplace, a strong safety record, and ongoing employee education and advancement opportunities as foundations for sustained growth.
